# README visual evidence

Captured on 2026-10-20 from the local Markdown preview at a matching 856 × 911 viewport.
The before files render main at `b32721d4a362906f1a4c7fef95d95387a52dd7d0`.
The after files render this PR's actual README sources and committed SVGs, with the remote status
card seeded at `7bb1903842e6275259feb0eaa5e9ce78037ec2d9` on `readme-status`.

These are local Markdown-renderer captures, not DSH runtime screenshots or GitHub-page captures.
The preview's language, theme and width controls are not part of the README.

- `before-zh-day.png` / `after-zh-day.png`: Chinese first screen.
- `before-en-day.png` / `after-en-day.png`: English first screen.
- `community-zh-day.png`: community table with working image links.
- `status-zh-day.png` / `status-zh-night.png`: real repository snapshot and counting rules.
- `community-en-narrow-night.png`: English community table at a 388px article width; no horizontal overflow.

The video URL/poster and all eight release-highlight rows are unchanged from the base in both
languages. The status card describes 30-day closed PRs (including merged PRs) and all reachable
default-branch commits, including merge and bot commits. Published counts change with later runs.
